name: io.github.GermaniU/mineru-mcp
title: MinerU MCP
description: Parse PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and images to Markdown (tables, LaTeX) via a self-hosted MinerU API.

runtimeArguments.name: --add-host
runtimeArguments.description: Lets the container reach a mineru-api running on the Docker host (needed on Linux; harmless on Docker Desktop).

environmentVariables.name: MINERU_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the mineru-api engine. Only loopback or host.docker.internal is accepted; any other host is treated as external and documents are not sent.

environmentVariables.name: MINERU_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Backend used when a call leaves backend empty. pipeline needs the least VRAM; hybrid-engine and vlm-engine need ~4GB.

environmentVariables.name: MINERU_PARSE_METHOD
environmentVariables.description: Extraction method used when a call leaves parse_method empty.

environmentVariables.name: MINERU_LANG
environmentVariables.description: OCR language used when a call leaves lang empty.
